([[Wolfeboro, New Hampshire]]) | college = [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]] (2014–2018) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | highlights = * Consensus first-team [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] ([[2018 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2018]]) * [[Big 12 Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Big 12 Player of the Year]] (2018) * First-team All-[[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] (2018) * Second-team All-Big 12 (2017) * Big 12 All-Defensive Team (2016) * [[Big 12 Men's Basketball Tournament|Big 12 Tournament]] MVP ([[2016 Big 12 Men's Basketball Tournament|2016]]) | medal_templates = {{MedalSport | Men’s [[basketball]]}} {{MedalCountry|{{USA}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[Summer Universiade]]}} {{MedalGold| [[Basketball at the 2015 Summer Universiade|2015 Gwangju]] | [[United States men's national basketball team|Team competition]]}} }} '''Devonte' Graham''' (born February 22, 1995) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[University of Kansas]]. He played [[point guard]] for the [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Jayhawks]]. ==High school career== Graham attended [[Needham B. Broughton High School]] in [[Raleigh, North Carolina]], leading the team to the 4A state championship game and a 26-6 record in 2012-13 while he averaged 15.7 points and 5.4 assists per game. The following season, he transferred to [[Brewster Academy]], in [[Wolfeboro, New Hampshire]], where he averaged 17.2 points and 5.0 assists per game and led the team to the national prep championship.{{cite web|title=Devonte' Graham|url=http://www.kuathletics.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=5848|website=[[Kansas Jayhawks]]|accessdate=June 14, 2017}} Prior to transferring to Brewster, Graham was not highly recruited and originally committed to [[Appalachian State Mountaineers men's basketball|Appalachian State]]. After a good senior year he de-committed and signed with Kansas.{{cite news|last1=Newell|first1=Jesse|title=Appalachian State coach who let Devonte’ Graham go says he has no regrets|url=http://www.kansascity.com/sports/spt-columns-blogs/campus-corner/article77253202.html|accessdate=June 14, 2017|date=May 12, 2016}} ==College career== As a freshman, Graham averaged 5.7 points and 2.1 assists per game. He had a season-high 20 points against [[Texas Christian University|TCU]] on February 21, 2015. In the NCAA Tournament, he scored 17 points against [[Wichita State Shockers men's basketball|Wichita State]]. After scoring a then career-high 27 points on 8-of-13 shooting against [[Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball|Oklahoma]], Graham was named Big 12 player of the Week for the week of February 14, 2016.{{cite web |url=http://www.big12sports.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_LANG=C&ATCLID=210715493&DB_OEM_ID=10410 |title=Wins Over Ranked Foes Help Graham, Burton To Weekly Honors |publisher=Big 12 Sports |date=February 15, 2016 |accessdate=February 15, 2016}} At the conclusion of the regular season, Graham was named to the Big 12 All-Defensive Team.{{cite web|title=Nation's Best Lead All-Big 12 Men's Basketball Awards |url=http://www.big12sports.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_LANG=C&ATCLID=210776703&DB_OEM_ID=10410 |website=Big 12 Sports |accessdate=March 6, 2016 |date=March 6, 2016}} He was named MVP of the [[2016 Big 12 Men's Basketball Tournament]] after scoring 27 points against [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia]] in the championship game.{{cite news|title=No. 1 Kansas overcomes No. 9 West Virginia to capture Big 12 title|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400871094|accessdate=June 14, 2017|work=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=March 12, 2016}} As a sophomore in the 2015-16 season, Graham averaged 11.3 points per game while shooting 46 percent overall and 44 percent from 3 point territory.{{cite news|last1=Bedore|first1=Gary|title=Devonté Graham’s personality and play pleases Self, youngsters alike|url=http://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article102762252.html|accessdate=June 14, 2017|work=[[Kansas City Star]]|date=September 19, 2016}}Trotter, Jake. [http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/22918865/kansas-jayhawks-devonte-graham-led-team-final-four In big moments, Devonte' Graham has been Kansas' X factor all season], ESPN, March 26, 2018. On February 22, 2017, Graham was arrested for failing to appear in court, resulting from an expired traffic ticket.{{cite news|last1=Boone|first1=Kyle|title=Kansas' Devonte' Graham arrested shortly after Jawhawks clinch Big 12 title|url=http://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/kansas-devonte-graham-arrested-shortly-after-jawhawks-clinch-big-12-title/|accessdate=June 14, 2017|work=[[CBS Sports]]|date=February 23, 2017}} As a junior, Graham was named to the Second Team All-Big 12.{{cite web|title=Three Teams Lead Men's Basketball Awards |url=http://www.big12sports.com/ViewArticle.dbml?SPSID=106110&SPID=13134&DB_OEM_ID=10410&ATCLID=211514295 |website=Big 12 Sports |accessdate=March 11, 2017 |date=March 5, 2017}} Along with [[Frank Mason III]], Graham formed the backcourt of a Kansas team that went 31-5 but lost in the Elite Eight, as Graham shot 0 for 7 from the field and missed six 3-pointers in a season-ending 74-60 loss to [[Oregon Ducks men's basketball|Oregon]]. For the season, he averaged 13.4 points, 4.1 assists and 3.1 rebounds per game. In April, Graham announced on Twitter that he was returning for his senior year.{{cite news|last1=Galloway|first1=Matt|title=KU basketball guard Devonte’ Graham returning for senior season|url=http://cjonline.com/sports/hawkzone/2017-04-09/ku-basketball-guard-devonte-graham-returning-senior-season|accessdate=June 14, 2017|work=[[Topeka Capital-Journal]]|date=April 9, 2017}} In his senior season, Graham was named the preseason Big 12 Player of the Year for the 2017–18 season.{{cite news|last1=Tait|first1=Matt|title=KU’s Devonté Graham named Big 12 preseason player of the year|url=http://www2.kusports.com/news/2017/oct/12/kus-devonte-graham-named-big-12-preseason-player-y/?mens_basketball|accessdate=October 13, 2017|work=kusports.com|date=October 13, 2017}} On November 28, Graham scored a career high 35 points in a 96-58 win over [[University of Toledo|Toledo]].{{cite web |url=http://kusports.com/news/2017/nov/28/devonte-graham-and-no-2-jayhawks-too-hot-toledo/?mens_basketball=&templates |title=Devonte' Graham and No. 2 Jayhawks too hot for Toledo |work=KUSports.com |date= November 28, 2017 |access-date= November 28, 2017 |last=Smith |first=Benton}} The following game, a 76-60 win over [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]], Graham again scored 35 points.{{cite news|title=Graham's 35 carries No. 2 Kansas past Syracuse, 76-60|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400986115|accessdate=January 15, 2018|work=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]}} Graham would go on to be unanimously selected as the Big 12 Player of the Year, averaging 17.6 points and 7.2 assists per game as a senior.{{cite news|last1=Trotter|first1=Jake|title=Devonte' Graham unanimous Big 12 Player of the Year over Trae Young|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/22644618/kansas-jayhawks-devonte-graham-unanimous-big-12-player-year-oklahoma-sooners-trae-young|accessdate=March 13, 2018|date=March 13, 2018}} He was also named a consensus member of the First Team All-America by multiple organizations.
